title: Scope content to the current workspace
description: Stamp a workspace identifier onto new records and filter reads and writes to that tenant boundary.
problem: Users should only see or manage records that belong to their current workspace or organization.
summary: Use collection access rules and a create-time hook to keep each tenant's data isolated from the others.
runtimeNotes: Uses function-based access rules and beforeChange tenant stamping for app-user workspaces.
